_comment: BuildTarget.fw is a real family for every provider now, not Optional[str] standing in for 'no family axis'. Getting this wrong either lets a malformed target reach a build silently defaulted to klipper, or breaks the fw filter ('rebuild knomi_serial everywhere') for exactly the types Step 7 gave a real family to.

mutations.name: a target with no firmware family is refused, not defaulted to klipper
a display's fw is its declared firmware family, not its own name
